annotations.title: List Wai engineering and finance calculators

description: Wai's deterministic calculators (computed by code, not by a language model): LCOE, project finance / IRR / NPV, DSCR, break-even, BESS revenue stacking, C&I and residential solar + battery, cable sizing and ampacity, short circuit, transformer sizing, earthing, surge protection, hydrogen LCOH, HVAC load, beam deflection, RC beam, pipe sizing, SPT bearing capacity, heat exchanger, open-channel flow, shaft torsion, FIDIC claim clock, construction cost, carbon offset, Damodaran valuation models and more. Returns each calculator id with its input keys and defaults. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call.
